values: 进入警戒状态，会在敌人释放终极技能时将其打断。
Lily May enters a Defensive State and interrupts the enemy's Ultimate.

被动地，战斗开始时进入“警戒”状态。当非召唤物敌军释放终极技能时，五月立即进入霸体状态，飞跃至其头顶向其发射一支禁魔箭，造成200% + 20% ATK伤害并打断其终极技能，使其失去700点能量，随后结束“警戒”和霸体状态。本技能无法打断首领敌人但造成的伤害提高400%。
使用终极技能时，选择一名非召唤物敌军或者自身，进入“警戒状态”。选择自身释放时，将对所有非召唤物敌军进行“警戒”。选择一名非召唤物敌军释放时，将只对其进行“警戒”，但五月会在其处于不可选中状态超过3秒或被击败后，转而对所有敌人“警戒”。
自动战斗时，只会选择自身释放。

Passive. Lily May enters a Defensive State at the start of a battle. When a non-summoned enemy casts their Ultimate, Lily May becomes unaffected. She then leaps above the enemy and shoots a Quellbolt, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage and interrupting the enemy's Ultimate, while causing the enemy to lose 700 Energy. Afterward, she exits the Defensive and unaffected States. This skill cannot interrupt boss enemies but increases Lily May's damage dealt to them by 400%.
Active. Lily May can trigger her Defensive State against all non-summoned enemies or a specific non-summoned enemy. If she defends against all non-summoned enemies, she will target the first to use their Ultimate. If she defends against a specific non-summoned enemy, she will target only them when they use their Ultimate. If that enemy becomes untargetable for over 3s or is defeated, she switches to defending against all enemies and targets the first to use their Ultimate.
When Auto Battle is enabled, Lily May automatically chooses to defend against all enemies.

Increases damage dealt by Quellbolt to 210% + 20% ATK.
禁魔箭造成伤害提升至220% + 20% ATK。
Increases damage dealt by Quellbolt to 220% + 20% ATK.

禁魔箭造成伤害提升至240% + 20% ATK。

对敌人造成多次伤害，期间处于无敌状态。
Lily May deals multiple attacks to the enemy while remaining invincible.
闪现至目标身旁，以神出鬼没的身姿对目标进行6次攻击，每次造成65% + 8% ATK伤害，期间处于无敌状态，随后返回自己此前的位置。若在释放本技能期间响应了“警戒”状态，则五月会在响应结束后继续完成剩余的攻击。

Lily May flashes to the target and attacks 6 times, dealing 65% + 8% ATK damage per hit. She remains invincible during these attacks and returns to her original tile afterward. If her Defensive State is triggered during the attacks, she will finish the remaining attacks after exiting the Defensive State.
在战斗中持续成长，每次成长会提升自身攻击力，并使后续箭矢额外造成伤害。
Lily May progressively grows stronger during battle, with each growth boosting her ATK and enhancing subsequent attacks.
五月可以在战斗中不断学习和积累经验。每当五月普通攻击或释放技能时，均会获得经验值，参与击败敌方英雄获得额外大量经验值。当经验值积累满后，五月便可获得一次成长，永久提高10%攻击力，并使自己接下来的4发普通攻击或者“疾雨之舞”的箭矢获得强化，额外附带目标3% + 0.6%最大生命值的真实伤害，最高不超过自身75% + 15%攻击力。成长带来的属性提升效果最多可以叠加4次。

Lily May grows stronger during battle. Each normal attack or skill grants her EXP points, with extra points awarded for assists or defeats. Once her EXP bar is full, she grows stronger, permanently increasing her ATK by 10% and enhancing her next 4 normal attacks or attacks from Rainstorm Ballet. The enhanced attacks deal additional true damage equal to 3% + 0.6% of the target's max HP, up to 75% + 15% of Lily May's ATK. This growth effect can stack up to 4 times.
强化箭矢额外附带目标4% + 0.6%最大生命值的真实伤害，最高不超过自身100% + 15%攻击力。
Enhanced attacks deal additional true damage equal to 4% + 0.6% of the target's max HP, up to 100% + 15% of Lily May's ATK.

每次成长带来的攻击力提升效果提升至14%。

When Lily May first interrupts an enemy's Ultimate, the enemy loses more Energy.
“腾跃落箭”首次打断敌人终极技能时，使敌人失去的能量提升至1000点。
When Lily May first uses Tempest Shot to interrupt an enemy's Ultimate, the enemy loses 1000 Energy.
